Builds polygons from lines, as the faces the lines enclose or as one polygon for each group of lines.

**Toolbox folder:** Vector Processing<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** Vector, Polygonize<br>
**Authors:** Antonio Falciano, Andrea Antonello<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.LinesPolygonizer`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inMap` | vector file |  |  | The lines to polygonize. |
| `pMode` | String |  | `faces` | How to build the polygons: faces, the areas enclosed by the lines, or join, one polygon chaining the lines of each group. Allowed values: `faces`, `join`. |
| `fGroup` | String |  |  | The field of the lines that groups them into polygons in the join mode (optional, all the lines make one polygon if not set). |
| `inPoints` | vector file |  |  | The points whose attribute gives the id of the polygon they lie in (optional). |
| `fId` | String |  |  | The field of the points with the id of the polygons (necessary if the points are given). |
| `fNewId` | String |  | `id` | The field of the polygons for the id. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outMap` | output file |  | The polygons. |
